designDecisions: UI3: Awwwards Renxa Recruit Site data visualization and Awwwards data-visualization inspiration were reviewed as research only; no external shapes, palettes, timing or interaction patterns were copied.

P-33 approved placeholders: exact headings/body/button, Surface/Border/Radius.L, Space.6 padding/inset, Space.2 body gap, Space.4 button gap, 560 maximum width; no extra text or illustrations.

DESIGN-CONTROL-CENTER §3/§10: use the existing token scales for rail/popup spacing and focus, real before/after Gece and Gun PNGs, accessible Turkish names and first-paint measurement; existing worklog is unchanged.
